# Nixflex documentation

- [Nixflex rules for AI](https://docs.nixflex.com/ai-rules.md)
- [Full documentation for AI](https://docs.nixflex.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Public OpenAPI](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/public.openapi.json)

## Business guide

- [Build and manage your business agents](https://docs.nixflex.com/): Set up Nixflex agents for calls, texts and website conversations. Follow dashboard guides or build with the API, and learn how knowledge and actions work.
- [Understand how Nixflex fits your business](https://docs.nixflex.com/what-is-nixflex): Learn how Nixflex agents, phone numbers, knowledge, campaigns and teams work together, then choose a dashboard or developer guide for your first business task.
- [Answer your first business call](https://docs.nixflex.com/business): Set up a Nixflex number and agent, test the answers, and start taking business calls with checked facts.
- [Read your dashboard overview](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/dashboard): Review call trends, outcomes and recent activity in the Nixflex dashboard, then open the right call, billing or status view for details.
- [See what's new in Nixflex](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/whats-new): See November's Nixflex changes: call one number, check booking results and use clearer knowledge and team controls.
- [Use the dashboard on your phone](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/using-on-phone): Use the compact Nixflex phone dashboard, open call filters and details, adjust text size and move from an in-app browser to Safari or Chrome.
- [Set up your business agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/agents): Create a Nixflex agent, choose its job, voice and language, attach reviewed knowledge and test the number before customers rely on it.
- [Write instructions for your business agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/agents/instructions): Describe the job, essential facts and handoff rules for your Nixflex agent, and keep call instructions separate from SMS and website text.
- [Choose your agent’s voice and language](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/agents/voice-and-language): Choose a Nixflex catalogue voice and conversation language, preview speech and test recognition with the names your customers use.
- [Test answers and call behaviour](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/agents/test): Choose a voice preview, knowledge test, browser call or controlled phone call, and verify real outcomes before enabling customer traffic.
- [Teach your agent your business facts](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/knowledge): Add and test checked business facts for one Nixflex agent, with guides for sources, keyterms and fixing answers.
- [Add and review your business facts](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/knowledge/add-facts): Add text, files or website pages to Nixflex knowledge, then review and approve topics before they go live.
- [Help your agent recognise names](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/knowledge/keyterms): Review From your knowledge hints, add manual keyterms and test difficult names without promising perfect recognition.
- [Test and fix your knowledge answers](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/knowledge/test-and-fix): Check Nixflex knowledge with customer questions, fix missing facts and make a separate call to test the complete agent.
- [Connect and move your business phone number](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/phone-numbers): Connect a business phone number to a Nixflex agent, check its channel switches and move it to another agent while keeping the number’s saved settings.
- [Update a number’s carrier connection details](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/phone-numbers/update-carrier-details): Replace private carrier details for an existing business number, preserve its settings and handle pending or uncertain changes safely.
- [Fix a number that reaches the wrong agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/phone-numbers/fix-routing): Check number assignment, channel switches and inherited settings before moving a business number or repeating an uncertain routing change.
- [Handle calls and review customer outcomes](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/calls): Choose a Nixflex call task, from answering customers and calling one number to checking recordings, bookings and live monitoring.
- [Answer support calls and hand off to your team](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/inbound-support): Build a Nixflex support phone agent with reviewed business knowledge, useful text replies and a tested transfer path when a customer needs a person.
- [Call one number from your dashboard](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/call-one-number): Choose an agent and number, check the recipient’s local hours, confirm permission and follow one outgoing call.
- [Review your calls and confirmed outcomes](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/call-history): Find calls, read transcripts and confirmed booking results, and check recording states without assuming an action succeeded.
- [Find, play and download a call recording](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/call-history/recordings): Use authorised recording access, refresh expired links and distinguish processing or unavailable audio from recordings held in your own bucket.
- [Check the booking result of a call](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/booking-results): Read the final appointment and timeline from a Nixflex call, and recognise processing, unavailable or deleted details.
- [Listen to a live call and take over](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/live-monitoring): Use Nixflex Live Monitor to listen to eligible calls, follow the conversation and take over when needed, with clear team access and call-ending rules.
- [Set up transfers, texts and voicemail](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/call-actions): Choose how your Nixflex phone agent transfers calls, sends texts, leaves voicemail and ends conversations, then test the complete action with your team.
- [Check call actions and test their fallbacks](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/call-actions/check-results): Verify transfers, texts and voicemail at their real destinations, then test unavailable paths without mistaking a spoken promise for completion.
- [Set up a receptionist that takes bookings](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/booking-receptionist): Set up a Nixflex booking receptionist, connect a calendar to your number, confirm appointment details and test the real calendar result before going live.
- [Take bookings with Google Calendar](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/google-calendar): Connect Google Calendar to a Nixflex number, set hours and caller invites, and check confirmed appointment results.
- [Change Google Calendar hours and invitations](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/google-calendar/change-settings): Update a number’s Google Calendar hours, appointment length and caller invitations, then verify the saved settings and a test booking.
- [Fix a Google Calendar booking problem](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/google-calendar/fix-bookings): Check the selected number, Google access, booking hours and confirmed result before repeating a booking or reconnecting a calendar.
- [Connect Cal.com for customer appointments](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/calcom): Connect Cal.com to a Nixflex business number, check the calendar setup and test appointment availability and booking results before serving customers.
- [Fix a Cal.com booking problem](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/calcom/fix-bookings): Check a number’s Cal.com connection, event type, time zone and appointment result before repeating an uncertain booking.
- [Take customer bookings by text](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/sms-booking): Connect a calendar and set up Nixflex SMS instructions so customers can ask about appointments, confirm their details and receive a checked booking result.
- [Call a reviewed customer list](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/voice-campaigns): Prepare a voice campaign, check recipients and local calling hours, confirm permission and review each result.
- [Review recipients before a voice campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/voice-campaigns/review-recipients): Check voice-campaign numbers, personal details, contact restrictions and local hours, then confirm permission for the exact reviewed list.
- [Check the results of a voice campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/voice-campaigns/check-results): Review campaign progress and individual call outcomes, distinguish waiting from uncertainty and check before starting more work for the same recipients.
- [Review opt-outs and customer contact hours](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/contact-controls): Use the Nixflex do-not-contact list and recipient timing checks to review outbound calls and texts, understand held rows and handle customer opt-outs.
- [Send texts and manage agent replies](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/sms): Choose Nixflex SMS tasks for automatic replies, campaigns, booking conversations and inbox review, with clear delivery and opt-out limits.
- [Set up automatic replies to customer texts](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/sms-agent): Set up the Nixflex SMS agent in the dashboard, write separate text instructions, enable replies and test questions and bookings on your business number.
- [Prepare and send a customer text campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/sms-campaigns): Build a Nixflex SMS campaign with reviewed messages and recipients, check permission and local sending hours, then track delivery and manage incoming replies.
- [Review messages and recipients before sending](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/sms-campaigns/review-recipients): Check each SMS recipient’s rendered message, missing details, segment estimate, permission and local sending hours before launching once.
- [Check SMS delivery and customer replies](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/sms-campaigns/check-delivery): Read per-recipient SMS delivery, saved messages and waiting reasons, then check replies separately without resending an uncertain message.
- [Read and organise customer conversations](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/agent-inbox): Review SMS and website conversations in Nixflex, filter unread threads, inspect customer details and archive old conversations without deleting their messages.
- [Add chat and voice to your website](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/voice-widget): Set up a Nixflex website agent, choose its look and contact fields, write website instructions and test chat and voice before installing the saved snippet.
- [Check website chat and voice conversations](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/website/check-conversations): Test the installed website agent, check the correct number’s inbox and distinguish loading, visitor details and saved conversations from successful actions.
- [Send call results to your business tools](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/integrations): Connect business tools to a Nixflex number, choose the right account or destination and test the saved result before relying on automated call follow-up.
- [Choose your own connected services](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/bring-your-own): Choose a customer-managed model, voice or recording bucket for Nixflex and understand connection checks, fallback and your own data lifecycle.
- [Connect and test your own model](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/your-own-model): Connect your own model in Nixflex, test its behaviour on an approved call and review connection failures, account-wide effects and actual charges before use.
- [Connect and test your own voice service](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/your-own-voice): Connect your own voice in Nixflex, test its behaviour on an approved call and review connection failures, account-wide effects and actual charges before use.
- [Store recordings in your business bucket](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/byo-storage-r2): Connect a recording bucket in Nixflex, test the saved settings and understand playback, fallback and your responsibility for files retained in your own storage.
- [Give your team the right access](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/team): Choose roles, invite colleagues with separate logins and review shared Nixflex work, credit and team activity.
- [Invite people to your team](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/team-invitations): Invite an Admin or Member, help them join with the right email, and manage expired, resent or revoked invitations without sharing a login.
- [Choose the right team role](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/team-roles): Choose the right Nixflex team role. See who can edit work, manage billing, view charges, invite people, control API keys and transfer ownership.
- [Change a teammate’s role](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/team-change-role): As Owner, change a teammate between Admin and Member, check the saved role and review any separately shared access.
- [Transfer ownership to a teammate](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/team-ownership): Offer ownership to a joined teammate, let them accept with their own login and confirm both saved roles afterwards.
- [Leave a team or remove a member](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/team-leave): Leave a Nixflex organisation without deleting its shared work, remove someone with the right role, and understand live-call and shared-key access.
- [Review team activity and export a CSV](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/team-activity): Filter Nixflex team actions by person and date, understand Done, Not allowed and Not confirmed results, and export matching Activity records as CSV.
- [Manage your account and business records](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/account): Find Nixflex account tasks for billing, privacy, data downloads, personal login security, request Logs and organisation closure.
- [Manage your organisation API key](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/api-keys): Find the full organisation key, check its activity and limits, and rotate it carefully without sharing credentials in browser code or AI chats.
- [Review credit, usage and payments](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/billing): Review your shared Nixflex credit balance, top up when needed, check auto-recharge and compare usage reports with payment documents in the dashboard.
- [Add credit and set up automatic recharge](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/billing/add-credit): Add credit to the shared organisation balance, check the confirmed payment and review the card and trigger before enabling auto-recharge.
- [Check charges and download billing documents](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/billing/check-charges): Compare usage, payments and cost statements using matching dates and time zones, then download the right document for your records.
- [Resolve an uncertain or failed payment](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/billing/fix-payments): Check an unfinished top-up, declined card or unconfirmed auto-recharge setting in Billing before attempting another payment.
- [Choose retention and download business data](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/privacy): Review Nixflex retention choices, download business data and understand what leaving a team or closing an organisation does to access and saved copies.
- [Review retention for every agent and channel](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/privacy/retention): Set the account default, review existing agents and separate call retention from messages, caller memory and files stored outside Nixflex.
- [Delete call and campaign data](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/privacy/delete-call-data): Remove call or campaign content, understand queued hang-up and recording cleanup, and keep sent history and retained charges clear.
- [Secure your personal login](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/account-security): Set up two-factor authentication and a backup authenticator for your Nixflex login, and keep personal sessions separate from the organisation key.
- [Investigate a request in dashboard Logs](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/logs): Filter API requests and webhook delivery attempts in Nixflex Logs, read safe error details, and investigate an uncertain result without repeating work.
- [Close your Nixflex account](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/privacy/close-account): Close the organisation as its Owner, download records first, and distinguish immediate access locking from completed data cleanup.
- [Move your phone workflow to Nixflex](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/switch-to-nixflex): Plan a controlled move from Retell or Vapi to Nixflex, keep the current service available and test real customer outcomes before changing routing.
- [Find product answers and shared definitions](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/business/reference): Find the Nixflex FAQ, pricing explanation and shared glossary without mixing task steps with API implementation details.
- [Understand usage and your business costs](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/pricing-basics): Understand Nixflex shared balance, call usage, website replies and external connection charges, then use current Billing information to review actual costs.

## Developer guide

- [Build a Nixflex integration](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides): Start a Nixflex server integration with one authenticated read, then learn errors, pagination, webhooks, knowledge and calendar workflows.
- [Make your first API request](https://docs.nixflex.com/quickstart): Read account usage from your server, check authentication, then choose a call, booking or knowledge workflow.
- [Authenticate API requests securely](https://docs.nixflex.com/authentication): Authenticate Nixflex requests with the full account credential, keep it on the server, rotate it deliberately and verify signed events separately.
- [Understand agents and number ownership](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/agents): Learn what a Nixflex agent owns, what belongs to a phone number and how separate channel instructions, knowledge and permissions shape conversations.
- [Many customers on one shared agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/many-customers-one-shared-agent): Map a customer to its business number and prompt, choose when to split agents, and route outbound calls, inbox reads and booking events safely.
- [Create and verify an agent with the API](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/agents/create): Create a Nixflex agent from your server, save its identifier, verify the configuration and connect an owned number without duplicating an uncertain request.
- [Write clear agent instructions](https://docs.nixflex.com/best-practices/prompting-guide): Write Nixflex agent instructions with a clear purpose, essential facts and action rules, then test ordinary questions, missing facts and failed actions.
- [Choose voices and speaking settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/voices): Choose a Nixflex voice from the current catalog and understand how saved voice settings affect conversations, without assuming every channel sounds alike.
- [Choose language and recognition settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/languages): Choose Nixflex language and recognition settings, understand route-specific support and test names, numbers and mixed-language speech on actual calls.
- [Understand conversation controls and actions](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/conversation-control): Understand Nixflex turn-taking, silence handling and action controls, and why clear instructions and real-call tests matter alongside enabled feature switches.
- [Use dynamic variables without guessing data](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/variables): Understand Nixflex call variables, campaign recipient fields and message placeholders, including missing values and the limits of saved caller context.
- [Understand caller memory and greetings](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/caller-context): Understand Nixflex caller memory, separate name greetings, explicit context updates and website visitor information before using returning-caller facts.
- [Understand settings across agent channels](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/agent-channels): Understand which Nixflex instructions, knowledge and actions apply to telephone calls, SMS and website conversations, including public visitor permissions.
- [Resolve number overrides and agent defaults](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/agent-inheritance): Understand how Nixflex resolves number overrides, caller memory, recording, SMS, voicemail and retention, without assuming every setting inherits alike.
- [Build an agent knowledge workflow](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/knowledge): Choose the right knowledge task: ingest sources, review facts, test answers, maintain exports or manage agent keyterms.
- [Add knowledge sources through the API](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/knowledge/ingest-sources): Create an agent knowledge base, submit text or files for review, and discover website pages without mistaking preparation for publication.
- [Review and publish knowledge drafts](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/knowledge/review-and-publish): Inspect prepared facts, save draft edits with current revisions, approve selected topics and confirm the publication job before using new answers.
- [Test and troubleshoot knowledge answers](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/knowledge/test-and-troubleshoot): Run an agent knowledge-only test, inspect supplied topic evidence and resolve missing, stale or loading answers without placing calls or sending messages.
- [Refresh and export agent knowledge](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/knowledge/refresh-and-export): Maintain saved knowledge sources, preserve reviewed changes and download a revision-bound export while handling stale jobs and cleanup safely.
- [Read and manage agent keyterms](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/knowledge/keyterms): Read automatic knowledge hints and saved manual keyterms, respect the returned limits and update only the writable manual agent field.
- [Understand how agent knowledge is used](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/knowledge): Understand how agent knowledge supplies business facts across calls, messages and website conversations, and what topics, sources and test evidence mean.
- [Manage phone number settings in code](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/phone-numbers): Read and update Nixflex phone number settings, move a number between agents and handle busy or uncertain results while preserving number-owned configuration.
- [Import and connect an owned phone number](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/phone-numbers/import-and-connect): Import an owned number through the API or dashboard and verify its saved agent and routing without exposing carrier credentials.
- [Move a number and manage its overrides](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/phone-numbers/routing-and-overrides): Move an owned number with an agent-only PATCH, understand inherited settings and read back focused changes without re-importing the connection.
- [Update number credentials or remove a connection](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/phone-numbers/credentials-and-removal): Replace carrier credentials in place, preserve number settings and reconcile uncertain routing or removal without deleting and re-importing.
- [Prepare a phone number connection](https://docs.nixflex.com/integrations/number-connection): Prepare an owned number for Nixflex, verify the target agent and connection state and reconcile import or removal outcomes without exposing credentials.
- [Understand phone number ownership and scope](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/phone-numbers): Understand how Nixflex phone numbers attach to agents, carry channel settings and move between agents without losing number-owned connections or history.
- [Build call workflows and read their results](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/calls): Choose the Nixflex call guide for inbound routing, outbound requests, recordings, analysis, live monitoring and retained results.
- [Understand inbound call admission and results](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/inbound-calls): Understand how Nixflex admits calls, selects number and agent settings, applies knowledge and actions, and prepares history after the conversation.
- [Understand outbound requests and call outcomes](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/outbound-calls): Understand Nixflex outbound call purposes, source numbers, recipient contact checks and campaign results before sending or retrying an external call request.
- [Prepare and reconcile one outbound call](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/call-requests): Save an outbound request UUID before dispatch, send one approved call and read its durable state without turning a timeout into a duplicate call.
- [Read call and booking results in code](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/call-history): Read call history, show all five booking-result states, fetch current recording access and reconcile delayed work without inventing an empty result.
- [Configure recording and private playback](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/call-recording): Configure Nixflex call recording, resolve agent and number overrides and request fresh playback access while preserving recording, retention and storage states.
- [Extract structured facts after a call](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/post-call-analysis): Configure Nixflex structured call analysis, handle missing answers and use summaries as reviewable information rather than proof of a completed action.
- [Configure outbound voicemail behaviour](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/voicemail-detection): Configure Nixflex voicemail detection and messages, understand number origin rules and test timing without assuming every answering system is recognised.
- [Configure telephone keypad input](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/keypad-input): Enable Nixflex telephone keypad input, ask for a bounded digit entry and distinguish received customer keys from agent-driven phone-menu navigation.
- [Understand live monitoring and takeover](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/live-monitor): Understand Nixflex live call access, monitoring permissions and human takeover states, including short-lived browser access and the limits of call controls.
- [Build a single outbound call](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/lead-qualification): Build an outbound Nixflex call for an approved recipient, supply a purpose and dynamic variables, then track it without repeating uncertain requests.
- [Connect call instructions to actions](https://docs.nixflex.com/actions/overview): Understand Nixflex calendar, text, transfer, wait and call-ending actions, including the permissions and actual results needed before an agent confirms success.
- [Configure a human call handoff](https://docs.nixflex.com/actions/transfer): Configure Nixflex cold or warm transfers, provide an appropriate handoff instruction and inspect the actual result when the destination is busy or unavailable.
- [Configure call endings and timers](https://docs.nixflex.com/actions/end-call): Configure Nixflex call-ending timers, understand the end-call control and distinguish a requested goodbye from a confirmed telephone disconnection.
- [Let a caller ask the agent to wait](https://docs.nixflex.com/actions/wait): Configure the Nixflex wait action for expected silence, understand the bounded wait period and test how it interacts with the ordinary call-duration limit.
- [Configure SMS during a phone call](https://docs.nixflex.com/actions/in-call-sms): Configure the Nixflex in-call text switch, request permitted messages and handle booking confirmations without confusing this setting with other SMS workflows.
- [Configure outbound phone-menu waiting](https://docs.nixflex.com/actions/ivr-navigation): Guide a Nixflex agent through telephone menus, configure its maximum menu wait and test keypad choices without promising every automated system will work.
- [Handle voice booking approval](https://docs.nixflex.com/actions/booking-confirmation): Require clear customer approval before a calendar change, handle number overrides, and separate saved settings from confirmed booking results.
- [Build calendar booking workflows](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/bookings): Choose per-number Google Calendar or Cal.com setup, mandatory voice approval and reliable booking-result handling for your Nixflex app.
- [Google Calendar bookings API](https://docs.nixflex.com/actions/google-calendar): Connect Google Calendar for an owned number, configure booking hours and invitations, and read confirmed booking results after the call.
- [Set Google Calendar hours and invitations](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/bookings/google-calendar-settings): Save Google Calendar time zone, seven-day hours, slot length and invitation preferences with explicit replacement and delivery rules.
- [Connect Cal.com bookings in code](https://docs.nixflex.com/actions/calcom): Connect a Nixflex number to Cal.com, use the agent time zone and confirmation controls, and check real calendar outcomes before promising a booking.
- [Troubleshoot calendar booking outcomes](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/bookings/troubleshooting): Diagnose calendar access, contact approval, availability and post-call booking states without confusing an accepted action with a confirmed appointment.
- [Build a voice campaign workflow](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/campaigns): Build Nixflex voice campaigns with reviewed recipients, duplicate handling, consent and local contact hours, then reconcile launch and cancellation results.
- [Prepare and launch a voice campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/campaigns/prepare-and-launch): Validate voice campaign recipients, consent, local hours and duplicate policy before creating executable campaign work once.
- [Track voice campaign results and controls](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/campaigns/results-and-controls): Read voice campaign state, resolve holds and cancel or resume unsent work while keeping queued calls, connected calls and final outcomes distinct.
- [Apply recipient contact controls](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/contact-controls): Preview recipient contact hours, manage business suppressions and handle locked opt-outs with the Nixflex API without treating a preview as permission to send.
- [Build SMS sending and reply workflows](https://docs.nixflex.com/sms/overview): Choose Nixflex SMS tasks for one message, campaigns, agent replies and inbox handling while preserving opt-outs and delivery uncertainty.
- [Send one SMS with the API](https://docs.nixflex.com/sms/send-sms): Send one text through the Nixflex API with an explicit owned sender, respect recipient contact checks and distinguish accepted messages from confirmed delivery.
- [Configure automatic SMS replies](https://docs.nixflex.com/sms/sms-agent): Configure Nixflex SMS replies with a separate number prompt, knowledge settings and eligible calendar actions, then inspect conversations in the inbox.
- [Build an SMS campaign workflow](https://docs.nixflex.com/sms/sms-campaigns): Create Nixflex SMS campaigns with reviewed variables, consent and recipient-local hours, then track delivery, handle replies and reconcile uncertain sends.
- [Prepare and send an SMS campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/sms-campaigns/prepare-and-send): Build SMS campaign templates and recipient variables, review consent and hours, and create one campaign while preserving uncertain outcomes.
- [Read SMS campaign delivery and controls](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/sms-campaigns/delivery-and-controls): Track SMS sent, delivered, failed and reply counts separately, cancel unsent work and reconcile uncertain sends without creating duplicate campaigns.
- [Configure post-call SMS follow-ups](https://docs.nixflex.com/sms/post-call-sms): Configure Nixflex post-call texts with a usable template, understand dashboard and API number rules, and avoid duplicate follow-ups after an uncertain result.
- [Build an inbox for SMS and web conversations](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/agent-inbox): Read Nixflex SMS and website inboxes, page through messages, use read versions and archive threads while keeping visitor identity and retention limits clear.
- [Configure website chat and voice in code](https://docs.nixflex.com/web-assistant/overview): Read and update Nixflex website settings with revisions, configure chat and voice switches and keep public visitor actions separate from phone capabilities.
- [Install and verify website chat and voice](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/website/install-and-verify): Install the dashboard-generated website agent snippet, verify effective channel switches and test the real site without exposing account credentials.
- [Troubleshoot website chat and voice](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/website/troubleshooting): Diagnose missing installation, stale settings, blocked microphone access and website channel limits using saved state and actual visitor results.
- [Understand website voice permissions](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/web-calls): Understand Nixflex website voice, the Web agent switches, public visitor context and restricted actions before enabling browser calls on your website.
- [Verify and process webhook events in code](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/webhooks): Verify raw-body signatures, save events durably, deduplicate booking results and reconcile missed deliveries through authenticated call reads.
- [Choose webhook events for your integration](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/webhooks/event-types): Choose call, booking and SMS events by what they prove, and keep pre-call callbacks, custom functions and unsigned reachability tests separate.
- [Recover delayed or repeated webhook deliveries](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/webhooks/delivery-and-recovery): Handle webhook timing, retries, duplicates and missed events with durable acceptance and authenticated reads instead of repeating calls or bookings.
- [Choose an integration workflow](https://docs.nixflex.com/integrations/overview): Choose Nixflex calendar, notification, custom-function and pre-call integrations, understand their scope and verify outcomes across calls and business systems.
- [Connect an agent to your business API](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/custom-functions): Connect Nixflex to a custom HTTPS function, verify signed requests, enforce business permissions and handle timeouts without repeating uncertain actions.
- [Provide context before an inbound call](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/precall-gate): Configure a Nixflex inbound pre-call hook, verify its request and return caller context or an explicit refusal within the fail-open timing budget.
- [Send call results to Slack](https://docs.nixflex.com/integrations/slack): Configure Nixflex Slack notifications for the intended number, protect the destination and distinguish a saved connection from successful notification delivery.
- [Connect call results to GoHighLevel](https://docs.nixflex.com/integrations/gohighlevel): Configure Nixflex GoHighLevel for the correct business number, protect credentials and verify external records before treating an automation as complete.
- [Build event automations with Zapier or Make](https://docs.nixflex.com/integrations/zapier-make): Connect Nixflex events to Zapier or Make, use the intended number-level destination and build duplicate handling around actual event and action outcomes.
- [Connect your own model, voice or storage](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/bring-your-own): Choose the supported Nixflex bring-your-own connection, keep credentials private and test fallback, scope and data lifecycle separately.
- [Connect a compatible model account](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/your-own-llm): Configure a compatible model connection for Nixflex, keep credentials private and understand verification, fallback and the boundaries of account-wide settings.
- [Use a voice from your own provider account](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/your-own-tts): Read a Nixflex custom voice connection, test speaking behaviour and understand account scope, fallback and credential changes before using it on calls.
- [Store recordings in your own bucket](https://docs.nixflex.com/advanced/your-own-storage): Connect Nixflex recordings to an S3-compatible bucket, verify access and handle storage fallback while managing your own object access and retention policies.
- [Build team administration in code](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/organisations): Read Nixflex organisation context, manage team invitations and permitted roles, and separate shared-key authority from personal login and ownership actions.
- [Manage team invitations and role changes](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/team/invitations-and-roles): Build team administration with personal role checks, invitation expiry and seat limits, while preserving unknown invitation and removal outcomes.
- [Handle ownership changes and account closure](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/team/ownership-and-closure): Keep ownership acceptance, leaving and account closure in the authenticated personal flow, and reconcile access, key handling and unfinished work.
- [Understand organisation roles and credentials](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/organisations): Understand Nixflex accounts, team roles, invitations, billing access and ownership, while keeping personal logins separate from the shared API credential.
- [Manage account behaviour in your integration](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/account): Find Nixflex account guides for usage, retention, authentication boundaries, request limits, error recovery and Owner-only closure.
- [Read usage and plan call capacity](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/billing): Read Nixflex usage and call capacity, interpret optional reservation fields and separate account counters from invoices and external telephone charges.
- [Understand retention and saved copies](https://docs.nixflex.com/concepts/data-retention): Understand Nixflex call and message retention, new-agent defaults, delayed cleanup and customer storage before choosing how long your records are kept.
- [Separate login security and API authority](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/account/security): Keep Nixflex personal sessions, two-factor authentication and organisation API keys separate when designing access to your application.
- [Handle organisation closure in your app](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/account/closure): Design around Owner-only dashboard closure, locked access and retained financial evidence without confusing closure with content deletion.
- [Trace API requests and webhook deliveries](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/logs): Use request IDs and dashboard metadata to investigate Nixflex API failures and delivery attempts without logging secrets or replaying uncertain writes.
- [Handle API errors in code](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/errors): Handle Nixflex error codes, keep unknown write outcomes visible and reconcile calls, messages and number changes before retrying work.
- [Build reliable paginated API reads](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/pagination): Read Nixflex cursor and offset lists without changing their filters, losing message ties or treating an offset scan as a stable snapshot.
- [Pace API requests and polling](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/rate-limits): Use Nixflex rate-limit headers to pace reads and polling. Keep HTTP request quotas separate from call concurrency, balance and knowledge limits.
- [Prevent duplicate work in code](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/idempotency): Save outbound call UUIDs and Knowledge operation keys correctly, keep their account binding, and reconcile other uncertain writes.
- [Switch from Retell or Vapi to Nixflex](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/switch-to-nixflex): Map an existing Retell or Vapi integration to Nixflex, rebuild the contract boundaries and test routing, actions and results before a controlled cutover.
- [Find Nixflex definitions and reference help](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/reference): Find the shared Nixflex FAQ, pricing explanation and glossary, plus the exact API errors and rate-limit reference.
- [Find answers about setup, bookings and billing](https://docs.nixflex.com/reference/faq): Find clear answers about Nixflex numbers, agents, calendars, website conversations, charges and recording access, with links to the current guides.
- [Check standard rates and separate service charges](https://docs.nixflex.com/reference/pricing): Understand standard Nixflex rates, separate telephone charges, shared credit and recording storage without assuming delivery or deletion is guaranteed.
- [Understand the words used in Nixflex](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/glossary): Learn the words used across Nixflex guides and the dashboard, including agent, phone number, knowledge, topic, source, campaign and team roles.
- [Debug failed requests safely](https://docs.nixflex.com/reference/errors): Investigate Nixflex API failures using safe request identifiers and machine codes, while preserving unknown write outcomes and non-JSON errors.
- [Understand API quotas and call capacity](https://docs.nixflex.com/reference/rate-limits): Separate Nixflex HTTP request allowances, concurrent calls, messaging capacity and Knowledge limits, then handle each refusal using its actual result.

## API reference

- [Use the Nixflex API](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/introduction): Explore the Nixflex API for voice agents, calls, numbers, SMS and knowledge. Find authentication, request fields, response shapes and examples.
- [Authenticate API requests](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/authentication): Authenticate Nixflex API requests with a server-side key. Understand account ownership, personal sessions and Owner, Admin and Member permissions.
- [Handle API errors](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/errors): Find Nixflex API error codes, HTTP statuses and recovery steps. Distinguish invalid input, permission failures, temporary errors and uncertain results.
- [Page through API results](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/pagination): Page through Nixflex agents, calls, numbers and knowledge. Use each endpoint’s limit, offset or cursor without losing filters or assuming one list shape.
- [Handle API rate limits](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/rate-limits): Handle Nixflex API rate limits using RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After. Keep request quotas separate from call capacity and feature limits.
- [Reuse supported operation identities](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/idempotency): Use Nixflex knowledge operation keys and revisions correctly. Learn which requests support replay and how to handle uncertain calls, SMS and other writes.
- [Retry failed API requests](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/retries): Choose safe retry behavior for Nixflex API reads and writes. Honor Retry-After, reconcile unknown outcomes and avoid duplicate calls, messages or purchases.
- [Track API versions and compatibility](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/versioning): Track Nixflex API compatibility, additive fields and retired routes. Preserve unknown values and confirm client support before changing a live integration.
- [Receive and verify webhook events](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/webhooks): Receive Nixflex call and booking events. Verify raw-body signatures, handle duplicate delivery and fetch private recording links when playback is needed.
- [Receive booking results: call.bookings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/call-bookings): Receive confirmed Nixflex booking actions and their final results after a call. Verify signatures, count active bookings and handle duplicate deliveries.
- [Understand agent settings and defaults](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agents/contract): Understand Nixflex agent fields, defaults, limits and nullable values. Configure call behavior, prompts, keyterms, retention and supported channel settings.
- [Create an agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agents/create): Create an agent and receive its agent_id for later reads, updates and calls. A successful create does not assign a phone number or start a call.
- [List agents](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agents/list): List Nixflex agents owned by the account. Read their settings and use each agent ID for detail, update or disable requests.
- [Get an agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agents/get): Read one Nixflex agent and its saved settings. Check whether it is active before assigning numbers or starting calls.
- [Update an agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agents/update): Update selected settings on an owned Nixflex agent. The PUT request is partial: omitted fields keep their saved values.
- [Disable an agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agents/delete): Disable an owned Nixflex agent. Understand the inactive state, retained record and checks before assigning numbers or starting calls.
- [List phone numbers](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/phone-numbers/list): List phone numbers owned by the Nixflex account. Read assigned agents and saved number settings before routing or configuration changes.
- [Get a phone number](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/phone-numbers/get): Read one owned Nixflex phone number, its assigned agent and saved settings. Use the encoded international number in the request path.
- [Import a phone number](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/phone-numbers/import): Import a phone number you own into Nixflex and assign it to an active agent. Review existing routing before changing the number configuration.
- [Update a phone number](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/phone-numbers/update): Update an owned Nixflex number's settings or move it to another active agent on the account. Review routing and uncertain outcomes before retrying.
- [Get number usage](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/phone-numbers/usage): Read usage for an owned Nixflex phone number. Check the response fields and account scope before using the totals in your application.
- [Update phone number credentials](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/phone-numbers/credentials): Update carrier credentials for an imported Nixflex phone number in place. Preserve settings and handle uncertain routing or credential saves safely.
- [Remove a phone number](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/phone-numbers/delete): Disconnect an owned number from Nixflex and clear routing managed by its import. This does not release the number from your carrier account.
- [List calls](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/list): Read the legacy call list as a bare array, newest creation time first. Use the documented filters and page limits.
- [Get call history](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/get-calls-history): Read a filtered call-history envelope with matching totals. History includes failed starts and omits transcripts, event data, extracted data and recording URLs.
- [Get a call](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/get): Read one account-owned call. Call completion is separate from recording, analysis and booking finalisation.
- [Read call booking results](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/get-bookings): Read confirmed booking results for a Nixflex call. Distinguish ready, none, processing, deleted and unavailable without guessing from a transcript.
- [Get a call recording](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/get-calls-id-recording): Read Nixflex call recording status and obtain a fresh signed download link when available. Handle unavailable, pending and deleted recordings.
- [Create an outbound call](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/create-outbound): Start an outbound call with an optional saved UUID. Reconcile replayed, pending and unknown requests without automatically placing another call.
- [Read an outbound call request](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/get-outbound-request): Check a Nixflex outbound request by its saved UUID. Keep pending and unknown outcomes distinct and avoid starting a duplicate call.
- [Handle call outcomes and safe retries](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/client-safety): Handle Nixflex call starts, active calls, deletions and unknown outcomes. Use confirmed state before retrying actions or treating a call as completed.
- [Delete a call](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/delete): Hang up and delete an owned call, track recording cleanup and safely resume queued deletion while retaining used charges.
- [Delete all calls](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/delete-all): Request guarded deletion of Nixflex call data for the account. Review scope, cleanup requirements and uncertain outcomes before another request.
- [List voice campaigns](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/voice-campaigns/get-campaigns): List this account’s voice campaigns, newest first. This bounded list has no offset or cursor.
- [Get a voice campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/voice-campaigns/get): Read one owned voice campaign, its saved schedule and current progress. Check wider-hours confirmation without retrieving recipients.
- [Create a voice campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/batch-create): Create a Nixflex voice campaign and its recipients. Default now mode requests launch immediately; use schedule mode to prepare a later launch.
- [Launch a voice campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/calls/batch-launch): Request the first launch of an owned Nixflex voice campaign. Check readiness, consent and launch state before dispatching calls.
- [Cancel voice campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/voice-campaigns/post-calls-batch-id-cancel): Cancel future work for an owned voice campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.
- [Resume voice campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/voice-campaigns/post-calls-batch-id-resume): Resume a bounded page of verified, unattempted recipients in a running Nixflex voice campaign. Review consent and current campaign state first.
- [Record voice consent](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/voice-campaigns/post-calls-batch-id-consent): Record consent or withdrawal for the current Nixflex voice campaign policy revision. Review the audience and policy before confirming.
- [Delete a voice campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/voice-campaigns/delete): Delete an owned voice campaign, stop waiting work and running calls, and keep sent history and used charges.
- [Send an SMS](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms/send): Send one SMS through Nixflex using an explicit, owned sender assigned to the agent. Distinguish acceptance from delivery and handle uncertain results.
- [List SMS campaigns](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms/campaigns-list): List the account's Nixflex SMS campaigns, newest first. Delivery totals cover all campaign recipients, beyond the current recipient page.
- [Create an SMS campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms/campaigns-create): Create a Nixflex SMS campaign and its recipients. Default now mode requests launch immediately; use schedule mode to prepare a later launch.
- [Get an SMS campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms/campaigns-get): Read one owned SMS campaign with recipient and message history. The campaign counters cover the whole campaign; the two history lists have independent cursors.
- [Update SMS reply settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms-campaigns/patch-sms-campaigns-id): Update reply behaviour for an owned Nixflex SMS campaign. This request does not edit the campaign's recipients, schedule or outbound message.
- [Launch an SMS campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms/campaigns-launch): Request the first launch of an owned Nixflex SMS campaign. Check readiness, consent and launch state before dispatching messages.
- [Cancel SMS campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms-campaigns/post-sms-campaigns-id-cancel): Cancel future work for an owned SMS campaign. Calls or messages already in progress may finish.
- [Resume SMS campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms-campaigns/post-sms-campaigns-id-resume): Resume a bounded page of verified, unattempted recipients in a running Nixflex SMS campaign. This can dispatch messages after policy checks.
- [Record SMS consent](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms-campaigns/post-sms-campaigns-id-consent): Record consent or withdrawal for the current Nixflex SMS campaign policy revision. Review the audience and policy before confirming.
- [Delete an SMS campaign](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/sms/campaigns-delete): Delete an owned SMS campaign, stop waiting work and running calls, and keep sent history and used charges.
- [Get knowledge capabilities](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-capabilities): Read knowledge limits, defaults and the account scope marker before enabling import, review and testing controls in your app.
- [List knowledge agents](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-targets): List active owned agents and their live knowledge state, then use the returned agent IDs for scoped knowledge operations.
- [Get agent knowledge](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-agents-target-knowledge-base): Read an agent’s own knowledge base, settings and current revision. Keep a missing base distinct from an unavailable read.
- [Set agent knowledge](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/put-agents-target-knowledge-base): Create an agent’s knowledge base or update its settings with the current revision. Saving settings does not publish source text.
- [Get knowledge base](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-bases-kb): Read knowledge settings, revision and the active published index. Use the current revision when preparing a guarded edit.
- [Get knowledge overview](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-bases-kb-overview): Read knowledge topic, token, publication and review totals, plus seven-day observations, without inferring publication from a source count.
- [Read automatic keyterms](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-agents-target-knowledge-keyterms): Read ranked automatic speech terms from live agent knowledge, with configured limits and saved manual terms for comparison.
- [Get knowledge usage](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-usage): Read private knowledge storage inventory and compatibility allowance counters. These values are not a complete billing ledger.
- [Read knowledge events](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-events): Read ordered knowledge events for the owning account. Keep the documented paging and filters while reconciling changes.
- [Measure knowledge source](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-agents-target-knowledge-base-source-measure): Measure source token usage before import without storing or publishing the source. The preview does not reserve later quota.
- [Import knowledge source](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-bases-kb-sources): Import pasted text or a supported raw file and track preparation. Review flags can require approval before publication.
- [List knowledge sources](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-bases-kb-sources): List accepted sources with unsuppressed live pieces. Use their saved source IDs for renaming, replacement and deletion.
- [Rename knowledge source](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-bases-kb-sources-id): Rename a saved knowledge source without changing its facts or published index. Confirm the exact source and revision first.
- [Replace knowledge source](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-bases-kb-sources-id-replacements): Prepare replacement source text while keeping the accepted version available until the reviewed replacement is published.
- [Refresh website sources](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-bases-kb-sources-refresh): Refresh selected saved website sources and follow the resulting job. New website content can still require review.
- [Delete knowledge source](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/delete-knowledge-bases-kb-sources-id): Remove an accepted knowledge source with explicit affected-topic confirmation and revision checks, then follow its result.
- [Discover website pages](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-bases-kb-website-discoveries): Discover selectable public website pages without importing or publishing them. Use the returned page IDs for a later selection.
- [Import selected pages](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-bases-kb-website-imports): Import selected page IDs from a completed owned website discovery, then follow preparation and any required review.
- [Get knowledge draft](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-bases-kb-drafts-id): Read proposed knowledge pieces, flags, reminders and the draft revision before editing or approving the selected content.
- [Edit knowledge draft](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-bases-kb-drafts-id): Edit a proposed knowledge piece while preserving evidence and review requirements. Resolve revision conflicts before saving.
- [Accept knowledge draft](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-bases-kb-drafts-id-accept): Approve selected reviewed knowledge pieces and queue publication. Follow the job before claiming the new answers are live.
- [Discard knowledge draft](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/delete-knowledge-bases-kb-drafts-id): Discard a knowledge review draft while retaining the currently published knowledge. Confirm the intended draft before removal.
- [List knowledge topics](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-bases-kb-topics): List current knowledge pieces in stable display order and retain the returned topic identities when opening or editing a piece.
- [Get knowledge topic](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-bases-kb-topics-id): Read one current knowledge piece, its evidence and saved metadata before preparing a revision-guarded edit.
- [Create knowledge topic](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-bases-kb-topics): Create a manually written knowledge piece and prepare a fresh index. Check the resulting job before claiming publication.
- [Update knowledge topic](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-bases-kb-topics-id): Correct a live knowledge piece with its current revision and prepare a replacement index without silently overwriting newer work.
- [Delete knowledge topic](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/delete-knowledge-bases-kb-topics-id): Remove a current knowledge piece and prevent a source refresh from restoring it. Confirm the revision and track the returned work.
- [Search knowledge topics](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-bases-kb-topic-search): Find related current topics in one knowledge base for management. Search results do not predict an agent’s answer on a real call.
- [List unanswered questions](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-bases-kb-unanswered): Read recent real questions without a retrieval match. Review the question before turning it into a trusted knowledge answer.
- [Update knowledge settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/patch-knowledge-bases-kb-settings): Update knowledge channels, matching mode or the not-found sentence, using the required guards and preserving omitted settings.
- [Start knowledge test](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-agents-target-knowledge-base-test-sessions): Start a knowledge-only simulated session for an agent with live knowledge. This does not place a real telephone call.
- [Get knowledge test session](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-test-sessions-id): Read the saved knowledge-test conversation and current session state. Missing answers and failed reads remain unconfirmed.
- [Ask a knowledge test question](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-test-sessions-id-messages): Ask a simulated knowledge question and inspect its supplied-piece evidence. Keep one operation identity for the intended message.
- [Cancel knowledge test](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-test-sessions-id-cancel): Cancel a simulated knowledge session and related unfinished work. Cancellation does not undo work already performed.
- [Get knowledge job](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-jobs-id): Read knowledge job state, progress, result and safe failure details. Interpret readiness using the job kind and result.
- [Retry knowledge job](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-jobs-id-retry): Retry a failed knowledge job only when its revision and attempt limit permit it. Review the recorded cause first.
- [Cancel knowledge job](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-jobs-id-cancel): Cancel unfinished knowledge work before installation while keeping published knowledge and work already performed.
- [Create knowledge export](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/post-knowledge-bases-kb-exports): Queue a private export of accepted knowledge and settings, then wait for readiness before requesting the download.
- [Download knowledge export](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/get-knowledge-exports-id): Download a ready private knowledge export as structured JSON or readable text through the authenticated export route.
- [Delete agent knowledge](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/knowledge/delete-agents-target-knowledge-base): Revoke an agent’s live knowledge and queue private-data deletion. Follow the job and remaining-object count to confirm cleanup.
- [Read web agent settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/web-agent/get-agent-web-number): Read website agent settings for one owned number, including its current revision and optional appearance configuration.
- [Update web agent settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/web-agent/patch-agent-web-number): Update website agent settings for one owned number using its current revision. A stale revision is refused so another editor’s change is preserved.
- [Check inbox availability](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbox-features): Check whether the Nixflex agent inbox is enabled on this service. The feature check remains available when other inbox operations are disabled.
- [List inbox numbers](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbox-numbers): List owned numbers available to the Nixflex inbox and their active agent labels. Pending number imports are excluded from the list.
- [List inbox conversations](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbox-channel-number): List conversations for one owned number and channel. Read-only listing does not mark messages as read.
- [Read an inbox thread](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbox-channel-number-thread-thread): Read retained messages in one owned Nixflex inbox thread. The newest page is selected first, with its messages returned in chronological order.
- [Update an inbox thread](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agent-inbox/patch-agent-inbox-channel-number-thread-thread): Update a Nixflex inbox thread's archive state or acknowledge messages through a known read version. Listing messages alone does not mark them read.
- [Read inbox retention](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/agent-inbox/get-agent-inbox-retention): Read the Nixflex account retention default and inbox cleanup availability. Include a number to resolve retention for its assigned agent.
- [Delete caller context](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/caller-context/delete): Delete the complete Nixflex caller-context record for one caller on an owned business number. Review the record's scope before removing it.
- [Get caller context](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/caller-context/get): Read saved Nixflex caller context for one caller and owned business number. Handle a missing record without inventing previous caller details.
- [Set caller context](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/caller-context/set): Set supplied Nixflex caller context for one caller on an owned business number. Review saved-field behaviour and the response before retrying.
- [Import caller context](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/caller-context/import): Import caller context for an owned Nixflex business number. Each row merges supplied customer context into the caller's existing record.
- [Preview contact hours](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/contact-controls/post-contact-hours-preview): Preview recipient-local Nixflex contact windows without sending calls or SMS. Treat the result as advisory and recheck policy at dispatch.
- [List contact suppressions](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/contact-controls/get-contact-suppressions): List stored Nixflex do-not-contact entries in a channel bucket. Understand the all-channel bucket and how it differs from a combined list.
- [Add contact suppressions](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/contact-controls/post-contact-suppressions): Add Nixflex do-not-contact entries for future contact checks. Existing entries are retained; review the number, channel and suppression reason.
- [Remove a contact suppression](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/contact-controls/delete-contact-suppressions): Remove one explicitly removable, owner-created Nixflex suppression. Recipient opt-outs and entries without removal permission remain protected.
- [Get Cal.com settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-calcom-number-phoneNumber): Read the saved Cal.com settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
- [Set Cal.com settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-calcom-number-phoneNumber): Replace Cal.com settings for one owned number. Omitted configuration values do not retain the previous saved values.
- [Delete Cal.com settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-calcom-number-phoneNumber): Remove saved Cal.com settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.
- [Connect Google Calendar](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/google-calendar): Connect Google Calendar to an owned Nixflex number. Create a consent link, handle return codes and keep OAuth credentials private.
- [Get Google Calendar status](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/google-calendar-status): Read the Google Calendar connection for an owned Nixflex number, including reconnect state and whether caller invitations are enabled.
- [Disconnect Google Calendar](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/google-calendar-disconnect): Disconnect Google Calendar from an owned Nixflex number. Remove local access and understand in-flight bookings and shared Google grants.
- [Update Google Calendar settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/google-calendar-settings): Set calendar timezone, weekly hours, slot length and caller invitations for an owned Nixflex number. Omitted settings retain their saved value.
- [Get Slack settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-slack-number-phoneNumber): Read the saved Slack settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
- [Set Slack settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-slack-number-phoneNumber): Replace saved Slack settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration and review omitted-field behaviour.
- [Delete Slack settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-slack-number-phoneNumber): Remove saved Slack settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.
- [Get Zapier settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-zapier-number-phoneNumber): Read the saved Zapier settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
- [Set Zapier settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-zapier-number-phoneNumber): Replace Zapier settings for one owned number, then read back the destination. Saving it does not prove event delivery.
- [Delete Zapier settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-zapier-number-phoneNumber): Remove saved Zapier settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.
- [Get Make settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-make-number-phoneNumber): Read the saved Make settings for an owned phone number. Secret values are represented by configuration flags.
- [Set Make settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-make-number-phoneNumber): Replace saved Make settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration and review omitted-field behaviour.
- [Delete Make settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-make-number-phoneNumber): Remove the saved Make configuration scoped to this account and number. This does not disconnect the phone number. A missing configuration also returns success.
- [Get GoHighLevel settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-gohighlevel-number-phoneNumber): Read saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. Configuration flags indicate secret presence without returning secret values.
- [Set GoHighLevel settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-gohighlevel-number-phoneNumber): Replace saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. Supply the complete intended configuration for this integration.
- [Delete GoHighLevel settings](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-gohighlevel-number-phoneNumber): Remove saved GoHighLevel settings for an owned Nixflex number. This clears the integration configuration without disconnecting the phone number.
- [Get pre-call gate for number](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-precall-number-phoneNumber): Read the pre-call gate for an owned Nixflex number. A saved number-specific gate overrides the default from its assigned agent.
- [Get pre-call gate for agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-precall-agent-agentId): Read an owned Nixflex agent's default pre-call gate. Number-specific settings can override this default for individual numbers.
- [Set pre-call gate for number](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-precall-number-phoneNumber): Set the pre-call gate setting for an owned number. A number-specific gate overrides its agent default. Clearing it restores the agent default when one exists.
- [Set pre-call gate for agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-precall-agent-agentId): Set an owned Nixflex agent's default pre-call gate. Number-specific settings can override this default for individual numbers.
- [Clear pre-call gate for number](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-precall-number-phoneNumber): Clear a saved number-specific Nixflex pre-call gate. Review the assigned agent's default when deciding the number's resulting gate behaviour.
- [Clear pre-call gate for agent](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-precall-agent-agentId): Clear the saved pre-call gate setting for an owned agent. This is the default for numbers on the agent; a number-specific gate takes precedence.
- [List custom functions](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-custom-functions-number-phoneNumber): List up to 15 saved custom functions for an owned Nixflex number. An empty list means no matching functions are saved for that account and number.
- [Create a custom function](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/post-integrations-custom-functions-number-phoneNumber): Create a custom function for an owned Nixflex number. Each number allows up to 15 functions with names unique within that number.
- [Update a custom function](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/patch-integrations-custom-functions-number-phoneNumber-id): Update selected fields of a custom function for an owned Nixflex number. Omitted fields keep their saved values.
- [Delete a custom function](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-custom-functions-number-phoneNumber-id): Delete one custom function by its account, Nixflex number and function ID. Review the response and missing-function behaviour before retrying.
- [Get first webhook](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-webhook-number-phoneNumber): Read the primary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. Primary and secondary slots are configured independently.
- [Get second webhook](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-webhook2-number-phoneNumber): Read the secondary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. Secondary and primary slots are configured independently.
- [Set first webhook](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-webhook-number-phoneNumber): Set the primary webhook for an owned Nixflex number. Review event contracts, signature verification and duplicate delivery handling.
- [Set second webhook](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-webhook2-number-phoneNumber): Set the secondary webhook for an owned Nixflex number. Review event contracts, signature verification and duplicate delivery handling.
- [Clear first webhook](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-webhook-number-phoneNumber): Clear the primary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. This request targets the primary slot independently of the secondary slot.
- [Clear second webhook](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-webhook2-number-phoneNumber): Clear the secondary webhook setting for an owned Nixflex number. This request targets the secondary slot independently of the primary slot.
- [Get web calls](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/get-integrations-web-calls-number-phoneNumber): Read the website voice-call switch for an owned number. Reading the saved setting does not start or prove a browser call.
- [Set web calls](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/put-integrations-web-calls-number-phoneNumber): Set the website voice-call switch for an owned Nixflex number. Review its saved state without starting a web call.
- [Clear web calls](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/integration-settings/delete-integrations-web-calls-number-phoneNumber): Clear the website voice-call switch for an owned number. This changes configuration without starting a browser call.
- [Check organisation roles and permissions](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/roles): Compare Owner, Admin and Member permissions in Nixflex. Keep server-side API key authority separate from personal dashboard sessions and membership checks.
- [Get organisation context](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/get-organisation): Read the Nixflex organisation selected by the authenticated credential, including its current permissions and account context.
- [List organisation members](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/get-organisation-members): List Nixflex organisation members, up to 100 pending or expired invitations, and current safety limits. Review role permissions before changes.
- [List organisation activity](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/get-organisation-activity): Read Nixflex organisation activity, newest first, with up to 50 events per JSON page. Check role permissions and paging rules.
- [Request an owner claim](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/post-organisation-claim-invite): Invite a verified recipient to claim an existing, unclaimed Nixflex API-only account. Sending the invitation does not complete the claim.
- [Invite a teammate](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/post-organisation-invites): Send a 24-hour Nixflex team invitation. The recipient must accept using their own verified login; opening the email does not add membership.
- [Resend a team invitation](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/post-organisation-invites-id-resend): Replace a Nixflex team invitation with a new ID and 24-hour link. The previous link becomes invalid and sending limits still apply.
- [Revoke a team invitation](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/delete-organisation-invites-id): Revoke a pending or expired Nixflex invitation before acceptance. The link becomes invalid; this does not remove an existing team member.
- [Change an organisation role](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/patch-organisation-members-id): Change a non-Owner Nixflex member to Admin or Member using Owner authority. Review the resulting permissions before saving the role.
- [Remove an organisation member](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/delete-organisation-members-id): Remove one non-Owner member from a Nixflex organisation. Shared work and the shared API key remain; review any separate access that also needs removal.
- [Rename an organisation](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/patch-organisation-name): Rename a Nixflex organisation using its API key or the Owner's personal session. Set the business name shown for that organisation.
- [Get the signing secret](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/organisation/get-organisation-signing-secret): Privately retrieve the Nixflex organisation signing secret to verify event deliveries. Keep it server-side and out of logs, browsers and shared output.
- [Create an API account](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/account/create-key): Create a separate Nixflex API-only account and its credential. This does not add another key to an existing account.
