- [Rotate the API key](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/account/rotate-key): Rotate the Nixflex account's API secret immediately while keeping its key ID. Plan the change because the old secret stops working.
- [Get account usage](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/account/usage): Read Nixflex account usage and call-capacity information. Occupancy can include unresolved reservations as well as active calls.
- [Get account retention](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/account-and-keys/get-account-retention): Read the Nixflex account retention default for new agents. Existing agents retain their saved settings until explicitly updated.
- [Get key activity](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/account-and-keys/get-keys-activity): Read a snapshot of retained Nixflex API request activity for the account. Distinguish request logs from call history and billing usage.
- [List voices](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/voices/get-voices): List voices visible to the Nixflex account. Check compatibility for the optional agent context before choosing a voice.
- [Get a voice](https://docs.nixflex.com/api-reference/voices/get-voices-voice_key): Read a voice visible to the Nixflex account and its compatibility with an optional agent language. A successful read does not guarantee compatibility.

## SDKs & CLI

- [Choose an API client or developer tool](https://docs.nixflex.com/sdks/ecosystem): Compare Node, Python, CLI and MCP, install the published packages and choose HTTP when a client does not expose the method you need.
- [Use the Node SDK in a server application](https://docs.nixflex.com/sdks/node): Install the Node SDK, make a safe read, persist outbound call intent and reconcile typed results without automatic mutation retries.
- [Use the Python SDK with sync or async code](https://docs.nixflex.com/sdks/python): Install the Python SDK, manage sync and async clients, save outbound request IDs and preserve unknown write and booking states.
- [Call the API from another language](https://docs.nixflex.com/sdks/other-languages): Use direct HTTPS with private bearer credentials, bounded reads and schema-aware error handling, then verify generated clients against the public contract.
- [Use the CLI with a private account connection](https://docs.nixflex.com/cli/overview): Install the reviewed CLI, connect your account at api.nixflex.com, understand private input and distinguish read retries from deliberate writes.
- [Make a safe CLI read and prepare a call](https://docs.nixflex.com/cli/quickstart): Verify the CLI account connection with a usage read, prepare an outbound UUID locally and keep any approved send separate from read-only recovery.
- [Find the CLI command for your task](https://docs.nixflex.com/cli/commands): Find reviewed CLI command families, exact call recovery commands, private credential inputs and confirmation boundaries before running a change.
- [Build approved workflows with MCP tools](https://docs.nixflex.com/sdks/mcp): Use the reviewed MCP tool inventory, prepare outbound calls without sending and reconcile saved request and booking states while keeping credentials private.

## Build with AI

- [Build your app or SaaS with AI](https://docs.nixflex.com/guides/developer/build-with-ai): Plan and build a Nixflex app or SaaS with an AI assistant. Define the brief, protect customer data and review calls, messages and results together.
- [Connect an AI assistant to your Nixflex account](https://docs.nixflex.com/ai-tools/overview): Choose a local AI client for the Nixflex MCP server, verify its 97 tools and understand approvals, private credentials and call-result limits.
- [Connect Claude Desktop or Claude Code to Nixflex](https://docs.nixflex.com/ai-tools/claude): Set up the Nixflex MCP server in Claude Desktop or Code, verify a safe read and try five prompts for agents, knowledge, calls, calendars and usage.
- [Connect Cursor to Nixflex with MCP](https://docs.nixflex.com/ai-tools/cursor): Connect Cursor to the Nixflex MCP server using private environment variables, verify the tools and try five prompts with clear approval and action limits.
- [Connect Codex to Nixflex with MCP](https://docs.nixflex.com/ai-tools/codex): Configure the Nixflex MCP server in Codex without saving a key in TOML. Verify a read and try five prompts for agents, knowledge, calls, booking and usage.
- [Use ChatGPT to plan and review Nixflex work](https://docs.nixflex.com/ai-tools/chatgpt): Use Nixflex docs in ChatGPT, compare hosted MCP and an admin-managed tunnel, and try five prompts with clear setup and account-action limits.
- [Manage Google Calendar with your AI assistant](https://docs.nixflex.com/ai-tools/calendar-settings): Use the MCP server’s calendar tools for human consent, status, settings and disconnection while keeping booking and email-delivery limits clear.
- [Update number credentials through private setup](https://docs.nixflex.com/ai-tools/number-credentials): Prepare private carrier credentials for the MCP server’s number-update tool and handle confirmation, missing setup and uncertain routing results.
- [Check call requests and booking results with AI](https://docs.nixflex.com/ai-tools/call-results): Use the MCP server’s read tools to inspect saved call requests and retained booking results without redialling or inventing missing outcomes.
